statement: let budget := fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x ≥ X, Real.log (((2*x)^2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ε*budget x

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0028 · 将单点对数损失吸收到任意相对预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0028 · Absorb a single logarithmic loss into any relative budget

brief.zh: 对 x≥2 将对数与常数倍 log x 比较，再取 x≥C/ε。
brief.en: Bound the numerator by a constant times log x and take x≥C/ε.
